hypervolume.detail: no reference point or objective directions are admitted for these metrics; a scalar ranking would be an unadmitted ordering

metrics.definition: non-blank lines of UTF-8 text files whose first 4096 bytes match /GENERATED by|Generated by ggen|@generated|DO NOT EDIT/, summed over git archives of the pinned SHAs
metrics.falsifier: re-running observe --check on the same pins drifts, or a pinned file carrying a marker in its header is not counted
metrics.name: generated_loc

metrics.definition: non-blank lines of the text files named by HANDWRITTEN.md ledger rows (first column) of the same pinned tree
metrics.falsifier: a ledger row names an existing pinned file that is not counted, or an unledgered file is counted
metrics.name: handwritten_loc

metrics.definition: non-blank lines of text files (>= 5 LOC, outside ggen-marketplace) whose git blob id is a blob of the pinned ggen-marketplace tree
metrics.falsifier: a file byte-identical to a pinned marketplace blob is not counted, or a counted file's blob is absent from the marketplace tree
metrics.name: marketplace_reused_loc

metrics.definition: lines of new derivable surfaces (non-generated .py,.ex,.exs,.rs,.ts,.tsx,.js,.mjs,.sh,.yml,.yaml,.toml,.ttl,.rq,.tera,.tmpl,.j2,.hbs,.sql,.go,.erl files whose blob changed since the predecessor pin) covered by a 6-line normalized-line window (sha256) occurring at >= 2 locations
metrics.falsifier: planting one copied window into a new surface does not raise the count, or a window occurring once is counted
metrics.name: duplicated_loc

metrics.definition: sum(killed) / sum(total) over the harness outputs named by final-lanes.json mutation_harnesses, each read at its durable locator
metrics.falsifier: a harness output at its locator reports a survivor that the ratio does not reflect, or a harness bytes digest differs from the recorded sha256
metrics.name: mutation_kill_ratio

metrics.definition: count of pinned text files carrying a generated marker in their header (projections of a generator)
metrics.falsifier: a marker-carrying pinned file is not counted
metrics.name: projections_count

metrics.definition: court entries of closure-final.json that produced a verdict (result PASS, FAIL or BASELINE_BLOCKER); BLOCKED courts are listed but not counted
metrics.falsifier: a court counted here has no durable evidence the release closure court resolves, or a verdict court is omitted
metrics.name: formal_courts_executed

metrics.definition: rows with an exact 40-hex subject_sha and a git: evidence container / all rows of requirements-matrix.json
metrics.falsifier: a counted row's container does not resolve or its digest does not recompute
metrics.name: receipt_coverage

metrics.definition: rows declaring the authority the requirement needs / all rows of requirements-matrix.json
metrics.falsifier: a counted row's container does not resolve or its digest does not recompute
metrics.name: authority_coverage

metrics.definition: rows whose evidence bytes have a recorded sha256 / all rows of requirements-matrix.json
metrics.falsifier: a counted row's container does not resolve or its digest does not recompute
metrics.name: evidence_coverage

metrics.definition: LLM/coordination edges of autonomy/edges.json whose status is RETIRED
metrics.falsifier: an edge counted RETIRED still carries a human or LLM hop in its latest receipt
metrics.name: coordination_edges_retired
